tickets.title: Home as a one-glance portfolio
tickets.what: Build Home from the settled design `docs/design/home-portfolio/` (D-2026-11-24-01): `README.md` sections 2, 4 (the ten text layout rules), 5 (Home column), 6 and 7 with the owner's answers at the end; `sample.html` frames are the template; `gen/proposed.mjs` `homeRows` and `gen/fixture.mjs` are the prototype rows and synthetic portfolio to port from (prototype only, not product code). In short: requests first only when any (header `? project › Objective`, work-waits flag, age; then the bare sentence, 2 rows); then one block per registered project: header row with liveness mark (running / idle / root gone), name in a fixed column, stance word when not active, priority arrow when not normal, idle word, running and queued jobs per role with the statusline's role icons, age; one stacked ticket bar row per open Objective (linked features' tickets, done/total, dropped excluded; panel's own bar glyphs and inks), ticketless Objectives a dotted track, paused Objectives grey (owner: show them), at most 2 then `另 N 个`; a result line under its Objective only if dated and at most 3 days old (owner); no `objectives.md` → one dim STATE Now line; unavailable root → mark and word only. Density tiers by free rows (drop separators → results → extra Objectives → one row per project); membership and requests never drop. Drop the pane load line (`This pane · N running`, owner approved this deletion). Carry the bare request sentence as a field instead of parsing the joined display text (README section 6). Keep navigation ids as listed in section 6 so Enter/click keep working. Update `docs/reference.md` Home section to match. Put shared text-layout helpers (sentence rows with a fixed hang, token columns, ages) where `project-view.ts` can reuse them in ticket 02. i18n en/zh, Nerd/Unicode/text icon sets, theme roles, no raw ANSI in `none` mode.

acceptance.text: Render tests over the design fixture at 40, 50 and 80 columns in zh and en: every row exactly the panel width, no row hangs deeper than 2 cells under a label, the blocked Objective shows its bar and blocked mark, the paused project shows a grey bar, the STATE-only project shows its Now line, the unavailable root shows its mark
Test: 17 registered projects in a short panel give one row per project and keep the request rows
Test: a result older than 3 days or undated is not on Home; a 4-hour-old dated result is
The pane load line is gone; Enter on a project, Objective, result and request row still opens the same targets

tickets.title: Project page carries the depth without repeating Home
tickets.what: Build the Project page from the settled design `docs/design/home-portfolio/` (D-2026-11-24-01): `README.md` sections 3, 4 (layout rules), 5 (Project column) and 6; `sample.html` Project frames are the template; `gen/proposed.mjs` `projectRows` is the prototype. Reuse the text-layout helpers ticket 01 added. In short: identity row (stance, priority, age); Needs you with the whole sentence (up to 4 rows); Objectives: head row (mark, id, `done/total 工单`, state word), full title wrapped (3 rows), next step (3 rows), one bar row per linked feature with counts, the running job under its feature (role icon, ticket, title, age), result (full, with age), evidence links (3, then `另 N 个`); a done Objective is one row; jobs no Objective claims in their own section. Details replaces `进度 / 工单 / 工作区 / 文档`, each row naming what it counts; a partial scan names its bound instead of `不完整`. Acceptance checkboxes only as a muted second figure at ≥ 56 columns. No Home summary bars or load line on Project. Keep the Project navigation ids and actions working. Update `docs/reference.md` Project section to match. i18n en/zh, icon sets, theme roles.

acceptance.text: Render tests over the design fixture at 40, 50 and 80 columns in zh and en: every row exactly the panel width, Objective titles never cut mid-word, the per-feature bars and counts match the fixture, Details rows name their counts and never say `不完整`/Partial
Test: a done Objective takes one row; a project with no `objectives.md` shows STATE Now/Next
Enter on a request, Objective, evidence and job row opens the same targets as before

tickets.title: Home: every project says something, and fresh finished work stays visible
tickets.what: Main session's live check of 01/02 on the owner's real panel (40 columns, zh) found three gaps against the design (`docs/design/home-portfolio/`, D-2026-11-24-01): 1. **Liveness mark missing.** `src/render/home-view.ts:56` draws `' '` for a reachable project that has no running jobs and is not `snapshot.idle`, so such a header starts with blank cells while a running project has ●. The design: ● running jobs, ○ no running jobs, ✗ root gone. Draw ○ whenever the root is reachable and nothing runs; keep the `空闲` word rule as designed. 2. **Projects with neither `.hud/objectives.md` nor STATE show only the name and a rule.** Three of the owner's five projects look like this. Give them an age on the header from the newest HUD job in that project (the job facts the panel already collects; no git or file scan at paint), and one dim line `无目标或交接记录` / `no Objectives or handoff notes`. A project with no jobs either keeps the dim line and no age. 3. **Fresh finished work disappears.** Home hides done Objectives, so a project that finished two Objectives today says nothing. A done Objective whose result is dated and at most 3 days old (the owner's 3-day rule) stays on Home as one bar row with a ✓ mark and a full green bar, plus its result line as designed; after 3 days it goes. It counts toward the per-project 2-row cap like the others (active and blocked first). Update `docs/reference.md` Home to match. i18n en/zh.

acceptance.text: Render tests at 40 and 80 columns zh/en: a reachable project with no running jobs shows ○; a project with no objectives.md and no STATE shows the dim line and the age of its newest job; a done Objective with a 4-hour-old dated result shows ✓, a full bar and the result line, and one with a 4-day-old result is absent
Every row stays exactly the panel width

tickets.title: Home sorts projects by what matters
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-24: on Home, projects with no Objectives or records (`无目标或交接记录`) sit between MyHUD and toktrack because `src/collectors/home-portfolio.ts` keeps the registration order of `projects.json`. Sort the project blocks: (1) projects with an open owner request first; (2) active stance, by owner priority (high, normal, low), then most recent activity (the age the header shows); (3) maintenance, then paused, each by recent activity; (4) projects with neither `objectives.md` nor STATE; (5) unavailable roots last. Ties keep registration order. The order changes only when activity changes, not per paint. Requests keep their own order. Update `docs/reference.md` Home.

acceptance.text: Test: a fixture with an active project, a paused one, a no-records one, a maintenance one and an unavailable root in scrambled registration order renders in the order above; a high-priority active project precedes a normal one; between two active normal projects the more recently active comes first
